risks.risk: Moisture/treated-wood status (could be wet or not heat-treated/ISPM-compliant), affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of any pallet stamp/mark (HT/DB/IPPC or similar) and a moisture meter reading (photo or short video showing the meter on the wood).
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed-condition pallets with unknown treatment/moisture (worst case: lower grade for reuse).

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch vs stated weight (500 kg) due to pallet count/size differences or inclusion of damaged pallets.
risks.proof: Request a photo/video of the certified scale reading with pallets on the scale (or a scale ticket).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be exactly 500 kg (worst case: assume fewer usable pallets).

risks.risk: Damage level (broken boards, weak stringers, missing nails) reducing load-bearing capacity.
risks.proof: Request close-ups of the worst pallets’ corners and underside stringers, plus a quick video of a pallet being lifted/checked.
risks.if_unproven: Price as some pallets may be damaged/less usable (worst case: discount for storage-only use).

risks.risk: Contamination/infestation risk not visible in photos (oil/chemicals/rodents).
risks.proof: Request a short inspection video (board surfaces) and close-ups of dark spots; ask about prior use (food/chemicals).
risks.if_unproven: Price with contamination risk discounted (worst case: cleaning/limited use).

proof_requests: Certified scale proof: photo/video of the pallets on the scale showing the reading (or a scale ticket).
Moisture proof: moisture meter reading on at least 2–3 pallets (top deck and underside).
Treatment/compliance proof: close-up photos of pallet stamps/marks on multiple pallets.
Condition proof: close-ups of the most damaged pallets (corners + underside stringers) and a short lift/handling video.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. From the photos alone, the key pricing factors (exact weight on a certified scale, dryness/moisture, and treatment/compliance) remain unverified, so pricing would be guesswork.
